metadata.name: fine-grained Kerr stability completion roadmap
metadata.status: assumes the current certificate framework is viable; records smaller proof obligations without upgrading the main theorem

nodes.statement: The first-chart backend residuals rho_R and rho_dR are exactly the Kerr trapped radial constraints R=0 and dR=0 after the recorded normalization.
acceptance_criteria: verify_carter_trapped_constraint_derivation.py accepts the trapped-constraint certificate
audit registry marks radial_trapped_constraint and radial_derivative_trapped_constraint exact_formula

nodes.statement: Enumerate the exact first-chart variable inventory for the gauge-reduced principal-symbol contract: phase variables, auxiliary variables, symbolic coefficients, and quotient variables.
acceptance_criteria: every variable family has a finite name list
the family partition is pairwise disjoint
the inventory matches the certificate interfaces already in the repo
blockers: variable families are only implicit in the existing contract

nodes.statement: List the exact gauge and trapped constraints used to quotient the raw Kerr principal symbol in the first chart.
acceptance_criteria: each constraint has a named backend symbol
each constraint is phase-free in the trace variables
the quotient role of each constraint is declared
blockers: the gauge and trapped constraints are not yet enumerated as a separate contract

nodes.statement: Register the primitive packet names and their intended roles before any principal-symbol formulas are exported.
acceptance_criteria: the packet registry is finite and ordered
each packet has a role (principal density packet or trapped constraint)
the registry matches the trace certificate names
blockers: packet roles are only implicit in the trace candidate

nodes.statement: Fix the gauge-reduced principal-symbol contract for the first-chart q_grav backend: unknown fields, gauge constraints, quotient variables, and source packet names.
acceptance_criteria: the backend contract names every principal variable and gauge constraint
the contract identifies which variables are quotiented by rho_R and rho_dR
the primitive packet names match the principal-symbol trace certificate
blockers: the gauge-reduced principal variables are still described prose-first rather than as an exact contract

nodes.statement: Export the raw linearized Kerr principal symbol before gauge quotienting as exact symbolic expressions.
acceptance_criteria: raw principal-symbol expressions are polynomial or rational expression trees
all denominator nonvanishing conditions are listed as interval obligations
the raw export is independent of the Carter cone normal form
blockers: no raw symbolic differentiation engine for the linearized Kerr principal symbol exists

nodes.statement: Reduce the raw principal symbol by the registered gauge and trapped constraints to a phase-quadratic source density.
acceptance_criteria: the quotient reduction is expressed as exact ideal identities
the reduced source is homogeneous of degree two in phase variables
rho_R and rho_dR are used only through the proved trapped-constraint interface
blockers: the gauge quotient identities have not been derived from the raw symbol

nodes.statement: Export the gauge-reduced linearized Kerr principal symbol in the first chart as an exact symbolic source density with named primitive packets.
acceptance_criteria: primitive packet formulas are sourced from the principal-symbol backend rather than a placeholder trace
the source density is phase-homogeneous of the correct degree
the exported primitives are compatible with the trace checker
blockers: no symbolic differentiation backend for the gauge-reduced linearized Kerr principal symbol

nodes.statement: Derive the radial-Hessian packet from the exported principal-symbol source and package it as the first exact density component.
acceptance_criteria: radial_hessian_packet is obtained by exact symbolic expansion of the source density
the packet matches the trace certificate exactly or modulo accepted trapped/gauge defects
the audit registry marks radial_hessian_packet exact_formula
blockers: the source density backend has not yet been exported as formulas

nodes.statement: Place the derived radial-Hessian packet into the existing coefficient tube and certify its interval enclosure.
acceptance_criteria: the coefficient enclosure checker accepts the derived radial-Hessian packet
the robustness tube still exports a positive margin
the interval formula is compatible with the first-chart normalization
blockers: the derived radial-Hessian interval is not yet sourced from a real Kerr backend

nodes.statement: Enumerate the raw superradiant frequency factors that enter the first-chart sign convention before any phase linearization.
acceptance_criteria: the raw frequency and azimuthal factors are named
the horizon angular velocity normalization is explicit
the sign convention is fixed before any packet derivation
blockers: the raw superradiant factors are not yet machine-readable

nodes.statement: Pin down the horizon angular velocity normalization used in the superradiant sign convention.
acceptance_criteria: Omega_H is an explicit rational or interval symbol
the horizon normalization matches the chart intervals
the normalization is compatible with the backend source density
blockers: Omega_H is only implicit in the current prose contract

nodes.statement: Fix the exact sign contract for the superradiant factor and its interval nonvanishing conditions.
acceptance_criteria: the sign of omega-m*Omega_H is declared and verified on the chart interval
denominator nonvanishing conditions are listed
the contract is suitable for later phase linearization
blockers: sign and interval data are not yet isolated as a contract

nodes.statement: Define the first-chart superradiant frequency contract: raw energy/azimuthal variables, horizon angular velocity normalization, and the sign convention for the superradiant factor.
acceptance_criteria: the contract fixes the raw variables entering omega-m*Omega_H
the sign convention is compatible with the backend source density
the contract lists the chart intervals needed for denominator and sign checks
blockers: the superradiant frequency normalization is not yet a machine-readable contract

nodes.statement: Derive the exact linear change of phase variables from the raw superradiant factor to ell-c*x in the first chart.
acceptance_criteria: the phase change is an exact rational map on the chart variables
its inverse or rank condition is certified on the chart interval
the expression reduces to ell-c*x in the trace variables
blockers: the linear phase transformation has not been derived from the raw Kerr variables

nodes.statement: Derive the exact phase map that produces the superradiant square variable ell-c*x from the raw Kerr symbol.
acceptance_criteria: the normalized superradiant phase variable is explicitly identified
the phase map is compatible with the current first-chart normalization
the derived expression can feed the trace certificate
blockers: the exact superradiant phase normalization is not derived from the raw Kerr principal symbol

nodes.statement: Derive the superradiant square packet s*(ell-c*x)^2 from the phase map and source coefficients.
acceptance_criteria: superradiant_square_packet matches the trace certificate exactly or modulo accepted trapped/gauge defects
its coefficient s lies inside the certified interval tube
the audit registry marks superradiant_square_packet exact_formula
blockers: the coefficient comparison to the interval tube is still candidate-only

nodes.statement: Certify the superradiant square coefficient enclosure inside the existing first-chart robustness tube.
acceptance_criteria: the enclosure checker accepts the superradiant square coefficient intervals
the tube retains positive coercivity margin
blockers: the exact coefficient intervals have not been exported by the Kerr backend

nodes.statement: Enumerate the raw angular variables and Carter constant inputs required before the q-variable normalization is defined.
acceptance_criteria: raw angular variables are listed exactly
the Carter constant input is named
the inventory is disjoint from the radial source variables
blockers: the raw angular variables are not yet isolated as a contract

nodes.statement: Fix the q-variable sign and normalization convention for the first-chart Carter angular contract.
acceptance_criteria: q is assigned a definite sign convention
the normalization is compatible with the trace certificate
nondegeneracy assumptions are explicitly recorded
blockers: q normalization is not yet separated from the wider angular contract

nodes.statement: Specify the angular-chart nondegeneracy and denominator conditions needed to linearize the Carter angular quadratic form.
acceptance_criteria: all denominator nonvanishing conditions are explicit
the conditions are local to the first chart
the data can feed the exact phase transformation
blockers: nondegeneracy conditions are scattered through the current prose

nodes.statement: Define the first-chart Carter angular contract: raw angular variables, Carter constant normalization, and the q-variable sign convention.
acceptance_criteria: the contract fixes the raw variables entering the Carter angular quadratic form
the q sign convention is declared
the denominator and angular-chart nondegeneracy conditions are listed
blockers: the Carter angular normalization is not yet a machine-readable contract

nodes.statement: Derive the exact phase transformation from the raw Carter angular quadratic form to q in the first-chart trace variables.
acceptance_criteria: the phase transformation is exact and rational on the chart variables
the transformation preserves the angular quadratic form up to accepted ideal terms
the expression reduces to q in the trace variables
blockers: the angular phase transformation has not been derived from the raw Kerr variables

nodes.statement: Derive the exact Carter angular phase map that produces the q variable in the first-chart normalization.
acceptance_criteria: q is explicitly expressed in the source coordinates
the map is compatible with the trace certificate
blockers: the exact Carter angular map has not been sourced from the raw principal symbol

nodes.statement: Derive the Carter-scale packet tau*q^2 from the angular phase map and source coefficients.
acceptance_criteria: carter_scale_packet matches the trace certificate exactly or modulo accepted trapped/gauge defects
tau lies inside the certified interval tube
the audit registry marks carter_scale_packet exact_formula
blockers: the interval extraction for tau is not sourced from a real Kerr derivation

nodes.statement: Certify the Carter-scale coefficient enclosure inside the first-chart robustness tube.
acceptance_criteria: the coefficient enclosure checker accepts the Carter-scale coefficient intervals
the tube retains positive coercivity margin
blockers: the exact coefficient intervals have not been exported by the Kerr backend

nodes.statement: Source the diagonal and bilinear slack packets from exact rational interval extraction for the true q_grav coefficients.
acceptance_criteria: rational coefficient extraction uses true Kerr coefficient formulas
diagonal and bilinear slack intervals lie inside the robustness tube
audit registry marks diagonal_slack_packet and bilinear_slack_packet exact_formula
blockers: true six-coefficient expression trees are not yet exported by the Kerr backend

nodes.statement: Prove q_grav equals the accepted backend source density modulo trapped/gauge ideal terms plus certified nonnegative square defects.
acceptance_criteria: source-ideal checker accepts the exact q_grav quotient identity
trace-defect absorber accepts any favorable square defects
audit registry marks trapped_radial_constraint_correction, trapped_derivative_constraint_correction, and backend quotient obligation exact_formula
blockers: exact raw q_grav expression is still missing

nodes.statement: Upgrade the first chart from model/source candidate to true gravitational q_grav coercivity with inherited 1/512 quotient margin.
acceptance_criteria: exact-derivation audit reports no open primitive entries
exact-derivation audit reports no open backend obligations
coefficient-enclosure chain accepts the true q_grav source
blockers: several first-chart q_grav packet derivations remain open

nodes.statement: Replace the shadow defect-transport edge by one genuine neighboring spin-half chart overlap with an exact rational phase pullback and positive phase-norm lower factor.
acceptance_criteria: defect-transport morphism checker accepts a non-shadow edge between named atlas charts
source and target charts are both present in the spin-half atlas
transported target margin is positive
blockers: no genuine overlap pullback has replaced the current shadow transport

nodes.statement: Build a finite defect-transport graph covering the required nonzero-spin trapped radial/angular chart family.
acceptance_criteria: finite graph checker accepts only genuine chart edges
every target chart in the declared cover is reached
minimum propagated margin is positive
blockers: complete angular-torus atlas is not yet certified
near-extremal chart family has no local seed certificate

nodes.statement: Export actual Kerr Carter-torus Fourier coefficients for a_KY and q_sr on the certified trapped atlas.
acceptance_criteria: Fourier input certificate is sourced from named Kerr symbols, not toy data
real conjugate symmetry is verified
coefficient truncation and approximation losses are rationally bounded
blockers: actual Kerr torus coordinate map and symbol pullback are not exported

nodes.statement: Prove strict rational lower bounds for the resonant Fourier averages on every certified torus chart.
acceptance_criteria: orbit-cohomology checker accepts all resonant lower bounds
minimum net orbit margin is positive after recorded losses
blockers: resonant lower bounds are currently shadow data

nodes.statement: Certify nonresonant denominator floors and weighted escape-symbol seminorms for the Kerr-sourced Fourier data.
acceptance_criteria: tame orbit-cohomology checker accepts denominator floors
weighted escape seminorm is finite and its derivative loss leaves positive residual margin
blockers: small-denominator bounds are currently shadow data

nodes.statement: Replace toy Wick losses by Kerr pseudodifferential loss budgets in the same symbol class as the Carter cone and orbit-cohomology certificates.
acceptance_criteria: finite-margin Carter-Wick checker accepts Kerr-sourced loss constants
assembly quantization allowance strictly dominates the exported Wick loss
symbol classes match between cone, orbit-cohomology, and Wick packages
blockers: no Kerr pseudodifferential remainder certificate is registered

nodes.statement: Convert the ergosphere Carleman pseudoconvexity condition into interval inequalities on the certified phase atlas.
acceptance_criteria: a Carleman interval checker verifies positive pseudoconvexity margins on every chart
commutator remainder budgets match the Wick symbol class
blockers: no Carleman interval checker exists
spin-dependent multiplier X_chi is not exported in atlas variables

nodes.statement: Fix the separated Teukolsky boundary-condition contract: radial ODE normalization, horizon ingoing basis, infinity outgoing basis, and spin/azimuthal mode conventions.
acceptance_criteria: boundary bases are normalized by exact local formulas
mode parameters and domains are declared
Wronskian or determinant normalization is fixed
blockers: boundary normalization is still informal

nodes.statement: Construct a meromorphic Fredholm determinant or equivalent Wronskian whose zeros encode the QNM boundary conditions.
acceptance_criteria: the determinant is analytic or meromorphic on the declared frequency domain
zeros are proved equivalent to QNM frequencies with multiplicity
poles and branch cuts are listed as certificate obligations
blockers: no determinant construction is registered

nodes.statement: Build a finite interval verifier excluding low-mode QNM zeros from the target resonance-free strip.
acceptance_criteria: the low-mode range is finite and explicitly declared
interval arithmetic proves the determinant has no zeros in the excluded strip
all numerical enclosures have rational error bounds
blockers: no interval determinant evaluator exists

nodes.statement: Prove a high-frequency exclusion estimate for the same determinant, uniform in the declared fixed-subextremal spin range.
acceptance_criteria: the high-frequency regime is separated from the low-mode interval verifier
the estimate is uniform in the declared spin range
all WKB or Stokes remainders have explicit bounds smaller than the spectral margin
blockers: no rigorous high-frequency determinant estimate is proved

nodes.statement: Replace the Stokes-functor slogan by a meromorphic Fredholm determinant certificate for the separated Teukolsky problem and a verified resonance-free strip.
acceptance_criteria: boundary condition normalization is fixed
low modes are interval-verified
high-frequency exclusion estimates are uniform in the declared spin range
blockers: no determinant construction or interval verifier exists

nodes.statement: Assemble trapped-superradiant Morawetz, ergosphere Carleman, spectral strip, red-shift, and horizon estimates into one linear decay package.
acceptance_criteria: all estimates share one gauge, foliation, Sobolev hierarchy, frequency decomposition, and symbol class
completion package records positive fixed-subextremal constants
blockers: linear estimates are not yet compatible across gauges and symbol classes

nodes.statement: Carter–Wick Quotient Positivity Assembly Budget: assemble per-chart Gram/SOS positivity certificates on the trapped-superradiant quotient ring A_chi = Q[r,eta,lambda,omega]/I_chi into a global coercive positive-commutator estimate, with explicit rational derivative-loss budget sum_alpha (M_alpha/mu_alpha)(1 + C_bump/w_alpha) <= B.
acceptance_criteria: finite contiguous atlas of Spec(A_chi) with explicit rational endpoints and overlap multiplicities
per-chart positivity certificates C_alpha = (U_alpha, v_alpha, G_alpha, mu_alpha, M_alpha) with Gram identity q_s = v_alpha^T G_alpha v_alpha in A_chi
bump partition of unity with explicit rational bump constant C_bump and widths w_alpha
budget inequality closes: total derivative loss <= available r^p+redshift buffer B
verifier verify_quotient_positivity_assembly.py accepts the assembled certificate
blockers: Carter–Wick symbol calculus on A_chi with stated composition rule and bounded remainder is not constructed
redshift-plus-r^p absorption of the L^2 error term in Step 3 of the proof sketch is not proved with stated uniformity
per-chart Gram certificates are toy/shadow data, not proved Kerr Gram matrices
bump construction with explicit rational C_bump and w_alpha on the trapped-superradiant torus is not carried out

nodes.statement: Turn fractional mode interpolation into uniform near-extremal estimates with branch-cut, horizon-regularity, and product bounds.
acceptance_criteria: fractional interpolation norm is precisely defined
constants are explicit as kappa tends to zero
nonlinear product estimates close in the same Sobolev hierarchy
blockers: space definition and branch-cut estimates are not yet theorems

nodes.statement: Put curvature-to-metric reconstruction, generalized harmonic or GCM gauge, and final Kerr parameter modulation into the same functional setup as the linear package.
acceptance_criteria: reconstruction loses no more derivatives than the bootstrap budget allows
Bondi flux modulation map controls M_f and a_f
gauge continuation criterion is compatible with the certified energy
blockers: global gauge and modulation package is still schematic

nodes.statement: Prove quadratic nonlinearities satisfy weak-null bounds integrable against the certified linear decay hierarchy.
acceptance_criteria: all quadratic source terms are classified as null forms, red-shift absorbed terms, or integrable remainders
energy inequality exports explicit C_NL(chi) and decay integrability constants
blockers: nonlinear source decomposition has not been carried out in the certified gauge

nodes.statement: Run the abstract continuity lemma with the certified linear, near-extremal, gauge, modulation, and weak-null constants to obtain the final fixed-subextremal nonlinear stability theorem.
acceptance_criteria: completion package has no open analytic assumptions
bootstrap smallness threshold is explicit for each fixed |a|<M
main theorem is upgraded only after every dependency is proved
blockers: multiple upstream dependencies remain gaps or speculative reductions
